facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2022-0030 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 30 January 2022 following 2 recorded events in the archive, including INC-2021-020 and NM-2008-0007. The change assurance record covers 2 clauses across 2 controlled documents. The intent is to introduce a duty the documents in scope did not previously carry. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the material unwanted event control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-HSE-005 and STD-HTW-004.
